VOTABLE.DESCRIPTION: LAMOST, the The Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope (or Guoshoujing Telescope) is an instrument tailored for producing large number of optical medium- and low-resolution spectra. Here, we publish both the medium (MRS) and low (LRS) resolution spectra from Data Release 6, http://dr6.lamost.org/v2/, to the Virtual Observatory.

TABLE.name: ssa_lrs
TABLE.DESCRIPTION: SSA-compliant metadata for LAMOST DR6 low resolution spectra; this data is also availble through Obscore; the collection name there is LAMOST6 LRS.

FIELD.name: nuc_ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS right ascension for this object from input catalogue

FIELD.name: nuc_dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS declination for this object from input catalogue

FIELD.name: accref
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Access key for the data

FIELD.name: owner
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Owner of the data

FIELD.name: embargo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Date the data will become/became public

FIELD.name: mime
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: MIME type of the file served

FIELD.name: accsize
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Size of the data in bytes

FIELD.name: ssa_dstitle
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: A compact and descriptive designation of the dataset.

FIELD.name: ssa_creatorDID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dataset identifier assigned by the creator

FIELD.name: ssa_pubDID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dataset identifier assigned by the publisher

FIELD.name: ssa_cdate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Processing/Creation date

FIELD.name: ssa_pdate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Date last published.

FIELD.name: ssa_bandpass
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Bandpass (i.e., rough spectral location) of this dataset; this should be the most appropriate term from the vocabulary http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/messenger.

FIELD.name: ssa_cversion
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Creator assigned version for this dataset (will be incremented when this particular item is changed).

FIELD.name: ssa_targname
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Common name of object observed.

FIELD.name: ssa_targclass
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Object class (star, QSO,...; use Simbad object classification http://simbad.u-strasbg.fr/simbad/sim-display?data=otypes if at all possible)

FIELD.name: ssa_redshift
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Redshift as estimated by the LAMOST pipeline.

FIELD.name: ssa_targetpos
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Equatorial (ICRS) position of the target object.

FIELD.name: ssa_snr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Median signal to noise ratio over all pixel, computed as flux/sqrt(variance)

FIELD.name: ssa_location
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS location of aperture center

FIELD.name: ssa_aperture
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Angular diameter of aperture

FIELD.name: ssa_dateObs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Midpoint of exposure (MJD)

FIELD.name: ssa_timeExt
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure duration

FIELD.name: ssa_specmid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Midpoint of region covered in this dataset

FIELD.name: ssa_specext
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Width of the spectrum

FIELD.name: ssa_specstart
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Lower value of spectral coordinate

FIELD.name: ssa_specend
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Upper value of spectral coordinate

FIELD.name: ssa_length
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of points in the spectrum

FIELD.name: ssa_model
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Data model name and version

FIELD.name: ssa_csysName
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: System RA and Dec are given in

FIELD.name: ssa_timeSI
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Time conversion factor in Osuna-Salgado convention.

FIELD.name: ssa_spectralSI
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Spectral conversion factor in Osuna-Salgado convention

FIELD.name: ssa_spectralucd
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UCD of the spectral column in the spectra served; when you have wavelengths, use em.wl for vacuum wavelengths, em.wl;obs.atmos for air wavelengths.

FIELD.name: ssa_spectralunit
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Unit of the spectral column

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxSI
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flux/magnitude conversion factor in Osuna-Salgado convention

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxucd
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UCD of the flux column

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxunit
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Unit of the flux column

FIELD.name: ssa_dstype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Type of data (spectrum, time series, etc)

FIELD.name: ssa_publisher
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Publisher of the datasets included here.

FIELD.name: ssa_creator
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Creator of the datasets included here.

FIELD.name: ssa_collection
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: A short handle naming the collection this spectrum belongs to.

FIELD.name: ssa_instrument
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Instrument or code used to produce these datasets

FIELD.name: ssa_datasource
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Method of generation for the data (one of survey, pointed, theory, custom, artificial).

FIELD.name: ssa_creationtype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Process used to produce the data (archival, cutout, filtered, mosaic, projection, spectralExtraction, or catalogExtraction)

FIELD.name: ssa_reference
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: URL or bibcode of a publication describing this data.

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxStatError
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Statistical error in flux

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxSysError
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Systematic error in flux

FIELD.name: ssa_fluxcalib
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Type of flux calibration (ABSOLUTE, CALIBRATED, RELATIVE, NORMALIZED, or UNCALIBRATED).

FIELD.name: ssa_binSize
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Bin size in wavelength

FIELD.name: ssa_spectStatError
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Statistical error in wavelength

FIELD.name: ssa_spectSysError
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Systematic error in wavelength

FIELD.name: ssa_speccalib
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Type of wavelength calibration

FIELD.name: ssa_specres
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Resolution (in meters of wavelength) on the spectral axis

FIELD.name: ssa_spaceError
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Statistical error in position

FIELD.name: ssa_spaceCalib
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Type of calibration in spatial coordinates

FIELD.name: ssa_spaceRes
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Spatial resolution of data

FIELD.name: ssa_region
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Rough coverage based on location and aperture.

FIELD.name: obsid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier for the observation; LAMOST observations typically result in multiple spectra.

FIELD.name: designation
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Target Designation (IAU style)

FIELD.name: planid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the observation plan

FIELD.name: spid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the Spectragraph that took the source spectrum.

FIELD.name: fiberid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the fiber used to take the source spectrum

FIELD.name: ra_obs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS right ascension of the fiber pointing (can be different from ra for bright sources).

FIELD.name: dec_obs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS declination of the fiber pointing

FIELD.name: objtype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Object type: star, k2star, fs, rvcandi, gal

FIELD.name: magtype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Designation of the bands of the magnitudes in mag_arr; this is not easy to parse by a machine, sorry.

FIELD.name: mag_arr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: An array of derived magnitudes. See mag_types for the bands these magnitudes are intended for.

FIELD.name: fibertype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Fiber Type of target (one of Obj, Sky, F-std, Unused, PosErr, Dead)

FIELD.name: target_comment
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Various comments (e.g., an external target id).

FIELD.name: offset_v
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Offset of the observation from the target coordinate (these are added for bright objects to prevent saturation).

FIELD.name: ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS right ascension for this object from input catalogue

FIELD.name: dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS declination for this object from input catalogue

FIELD.name: z_err
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in ssa_redshift as estimated by the LAMOST pipeline.

RESOURCE.name: sdl_lrs
RESOURCE.DESCRIPTION: Spectrum datalink service for LAMOST6 low-resolution spectra. This gives you access to the SDM-compliant data in various formats as well as the original FITS files.
